title: Okvorado — Network Snapshot
description: Réplique la page 'Network Snapshot' de NetFlow Analyzer : tableaux de classement du parc (314 équipements / 772 interfaces chez lui, borné par LIMIT ici). Top N Interfaces by Speed, Top N Interfaces by Utilization (%), Top N Devices by Speed, Top N Application. Chaque ligne Device IP / Device Name pointe vers la fiche exportateur (dataLink var-exporter).

list.name: exporter
list.label: Exportateur
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ExporterName FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) ORDER BY ExporterName

panels.title: Top N Interfaces by Speed — Device IP / Interface / Speed IN / Speed OUT
panels.description: Débit calculé sur la fenêtre sélectionnée : sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / durée_s, séparé par direction (InIfName vs OutIfName, potentiellement des interfaces différentes selon le sens du flux). LIMIT 20.

value.title: Voir les anomalies pour cette adresse
Voir la fiche de cet exportateur

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    exportateur,
    any(ip) AS ip,
    interface,
    sum(debit_in) AS vitesse_in,
    sum(debit_out) AS vitesse_out
FROM (
    SELECT
        ExporterName AS exportateur,
        any(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(ExporterAddress), '::ffff:', '')) AS ip,
        InIfName AS interface,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1) AS debit_in,
        0 AS debit_out
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND InIfName != ''
    GROUP BY exportateur, interface
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ExporterName AS exportateur,
        any(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(ExporterAddress), '::ffff:', '')) AS ip,
        OutIfName AS interface,
        0 AS debit_in,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1) AS debit_out
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND OutIfName != ''
    GROUP BY exportateur, interface
)
GROUP BY exportateur, interface
ORDER BY vitesse_in DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top N Interfaces by Utilization — Device IP / Interface / Utilization IN / OUT (%)
panels.description: Débit rapporté à InIfSpeed/OutIfSpeed — vitesse d'interface mesurée en Mbps sur ce ClickHouse (vérifié : DISTINCT InIfSpeed = 1000, cohérent avec des interfaces 1 Gbps homelab), d'où le facteur *1000000 pour convertir en bps avant le ratio. LIMIT 20.

value.title: Voir les anomalies pour cette adresse
Voir la fiche de cet exportateur

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    exportateur,
    any(ip) AS ip,
    interface,
    least(100, sum(debit_in) / (greatest(max(vitesse_if), 1) * 1000000) * 100) AS utilisation_in,
    least(100, sum(debit_out) / (greatest(max(vitesse_if), 1) * 1000000) * 100) AS utilisation_out
FROM (
    SELECT
        ExporterName AS exportateur,
        any(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(ExporterAddress), '::ffff:', '')) AS ip,
        InIfName AS interface,
        any(InIfSpeed) AS vitesse_if,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1) AS debit_in,
        0 AS debit_out
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND InIfName != ''
    GROUP BY exportateur, interface
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ExporterName AS exportateur,
        any(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(ExporterAddress), '::ffff:', '')) AS ip,
        OutIfName AS interface,
        any(OutIfSpeed) AS vitesse_if,
        0 AS debit_in,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1) AS debit_out
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND OutIfName != ''
    GROUP BY exportateur, interface
)
GROUP BY exportateur, interface
ORDER BY utilisation_in DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top N Devices by Speed — Speed (max) / Avg Speed
panels.description: Débit par bucket de 1 minute (toStartOfMinute), puis max() et avg() par exportateur — reproduit exactement la paire 'Speed / Avg Speed' de NetFlow Analyzer. LIMIT 20.

links.title: Voir la fiche de cet exportateur

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    exportateur,
    max(debit_min) AS vitesse_max,
    avg(debit_min) AS vitesse_moyenne
FROM (
    SELECT
        ExporterName AS exportateur,
        toStartOfMinute(TimeReceived) AS minute,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / 60 AS debit_min
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
    GROUP BY exportateur, minute
)
GROUP BY exportateur
ORDER BY vitesse_max DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top N Application
panels.description: sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) par application déduite du protocole/port, LIMIT 20 — même calcul que sur l'accueil, disponible ici aussi (constante n°2 : chaque graphe a son tableau, voir panneau ci-dessous).

links.title: Voir cette application dans Applications & QoS

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(
        Proto = 6 AND (DstPort = 443 OR SrcPort = 443), 'HTTPS',
        Proto = 6 AND (DstPort = 80 OR SrcPort = 80), 'HTTP',
        Proto = 17 AND (DstPort = 53 OR SrcPort = 53), 'DNS',
        Proto = 6, 'TCP autre',
        Proto = 17, 'UDP autre',
        Proto = 1, 'ICMP',
        'Autre'
    ) AS application,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
GROUP BY application
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top N Application — tableau de valeurs
